coverage_note: Engine: أمل at 05:05/05:43 (asta amal) and 11:08-11:14 (مش أمل party) is 3amal/asta3mel, not the name; 10:41/10:45 'بيكون أنا حفلة' = bikoon 3inna (dropped ع, S4); 36:50 and 37:52 'عليك' that Amal called Nice are likely -lak (chat bashtaa2lak / mishtaa2lek); 41:00+ بتخمس = bat7ammas (S4); 1:04:14 'الضياع إي' and 1:04:25 'إزعاج' are her recasts garbled; 1:05:07/1:05:14 تشتعي = tishta2i, his ما تشتي is a dropped ق (S4, not filed); 1:07:18 Cyrillic 'сода' = sada (black coffee). 15:53 'pantalon' likely بنطلون (chat bantaloan), not filed. 32:28-32:44 command answers lost ([foreign language]); 34:27-36:02 Medi away, Amal lines garbled. Echo: 'bilbesu' 04:46 = byelbasu. Self-fixes skipped: benent->benat 04:32, حكيت->بتحكي 06:51, بيساعدني->ساعد 09:18, سلّح->سلّحت 14:09, بعيد->بعيدة 39:42, ما تذأج مني->ما تذأجني 53:43, عليني->علي 59:19, متأخر->متأخرين 1:02:23, بحب->بحبها 1:06:41. Rule questions not filed (51:51-52:24 بأذ, 53:17, 58:09).

rows.medi_said: benat akhui, uh, be, um, bitilbis, uh, costume.
rows.amal_said: تلبس؟ ... مم. إنت إيش راح تلبس؟
rows.chat: bukra Halloween u banaat a5uy byelbesu  costume
rows.why: Subject is banaat akhui (they) but he used the she/you form bitilbis; she echoed تلبس؟ and he changed to bilbesu (they-form), her chat byelbesu.
rows.english: Tomorrow is Halloween and my nieces are wearing costumes.

rows.medi_said: Uh, tintain costume, uh, musta amal, um, kul seneh. ... Il tintain costume,
rows.amal_said: costume in? ... Costume in to costumes.
rows.why: Two of a noun is the dual ending (costumein), not tintain + noun; she prompted 'costume in?' and explained 'Costume in to costumes'.

rows.medi_said: خطيبتي, um, بتحكي لي إنه لازم أشتري، uh, أكتر costume من costumeين.
rows.chat: 5atibti bte7kili nno laazem ashteri aktar min costumain
rows.why: Comparative 'more than two' is aktar min + noun; he put costume between aktar and min; only her chat reorders it, no voiced fix.
rows.english: My fiancée tells me I have to buy more than two costumes.

rows.medi_said: سجاد طيارة أو طيا-- س-سجاد بطير.
rows.amal_said: مم. بيطير. [تضحك]
rows.why: The carpet (he/it) flies is بيطير; بطير is the I-form; she recast بيطير with a laugh and he repeated بي-بي-ب-بطير.
rows.english: Flying carpet / a carpet that flies.

rows.medi_said: سجاد طيارة أو طيا-- س-سجاد بطير.
rows.why: One carpet is سجادة (sheet: carpet | Sijjade | سجادةة); سجاد is the collective; Amal let it pass.

rows.medi_said: ميلاد عيدو.
rows.amal_said: عيد ميلاده.
rows.why: Birthday is the idafa عيد ميلاد + owner ending; he flipped the order; she recast عيد ميلاده and he repeated it.

rows.medi_said: كل سنة، uh... Do you have a party? And, and, uh...
rows.amal_said: We make a party. ... You could use بكون عنا. As a like because it's habitual.
rows.why: He switched to English to ask how to say 'we have a party (every year)'; she supplied بكون عنا (habitual) - a didn't-know.
rows.english: Every year we have a party.

rows.medi_said: الـ-- مش أمل party. أمل؟ مش، مش أمل party.
rows.amal_said: مم. Why miss-- No miss. Why miss? ... it's not miss. ... ما عمل.
rows.why: A verb is negated with ma, not mish; engine wrote أمل for عمل (3amal, he made) - not the name; she said 'No miss' and gave ما عمل.
rows.english: He didn't throw a party (this year).

rows.medi_said: مش أمل party.
rows.why: English 'party' inside an Arabic clause; sheet row 'party | 7afle | حفلة | 7afle' and he said حفلة at 10:41; pre-ruled do-not-correct (AR-1933).

rows.medi_said: سلّحت، أنا سلّحت الـ card بس نسيت خلصته، خلصتهم.
rows.amal_said: مم. نسيت؟ ... نسيت what؟ ... نسيت أخلصه. Second verb present.
rows.chat: ana salla7et el-card bas nseet a5also
rows.why: After a verb like nseet the second verb is a bare present (a5allso), not past خلصته; she said 'Second verb present'.
rows.english: I fixed the card but forgot to finish it.

rows.medi_said: أوكي، أنا راح.
rows.amal_said: أنا راح أحكي لك. We don't, we don't say just I will.
rows.why: Future ra7 needs a bare verb after it; he stopped at أنا راح; she gave أنا راح أحكي لك and said 'we don't say just I will'.

rows.medi_said: امم، pantalon سيكني في ود-- قمع. ... قمي-- قمع. قميء؟ قمع.
rows.amal_said: غامق.
rows.chat: el-yoam balbes qamees azra2 u bantaloan sakani 8aame2 u kundara binniyye
rows.why: He tried 'dark' and produced the non-word قمع several times; she supplied غامق (sheet: dark (color) | 8aameq | غامق).

rows.medi_said: امم، [تنهد] ما يخ-- ما، اه، ما بيخد، امم، ولا حدا؟
rows.amal_said: ولا إشي. ... Or ما بياخد إشي.
rows.why: Asked what the cat takes, he answered ولا حدا (nobody); a thing is ولا إشي (nothing), which she gave and he repeated.

rows.medi_said: بكرة لازم برجع على بيتي
rows.chat: bukra laazem arja3 3ala beiti 3ashaan ne3zem 3ailet 5atibti 3ala kabaab
rows.why: After laazem the verb drops b- (arja3); he kept برجع; only her chat shows arja3, no voiced fix.
rows.english: Tomorrow I have to go back to my house.

rows.medi_said: عشان نعزم إيلت خطيبتي لكباب.
rows.amal_said: على. ... على كباب. ... invite to. Did we review invite to?
rows.why: 3azam takes 3ala for what you invite to; he used la-; she said على, على كباب, 'invite to'.
rows.english: So we can invite my fiancée's family to kebab.

rows.medi_said: So بعزم عليهم،
rows.amal_said: No. ... You invite people to the wedding.
rows.why: The person is the direct object of 3azam and على marks the event; he put على on the people; she said No and he rebuilt بعزم حدا على.

rows.medi_said: عروس، عروسي.
rows.why: Context is inviting people to the wedding; عروس is bride, wedding is عرس (sheet: wedding | 3urus | عرس); she moved on without fixing; may be the engine.

rows.medi_said: ببسط.
rows.amal_said: No.
rows.why: 'I get happy' is the n-form banbeset; ببسط is the make-happy form (brief: بسط for انبسط is B12); she said No and he gave bandaset.

rows.medi_said: أنا بنبسط من، uh, من- من بنات خطيبتي لما...
rows.amal_said: بنات. بنات خطيبتي. [تضحك] Already?
rows.why: He meant his nieces (بنات أخوي) but said his fiancée's daughters; she echoed it with 'Already?' and he said 'Sorry, بنات أخوي'.
rows.english: I get happy from my nieces when...

rows.medi_said: لما بلبس costumes.
rows.amal_said: لما.
rows.why: The nieces wear, so the they-form; he used بلبس (I wear); she prompted لما and he fixed to بيلبسوا, then Nice.

rows.medi_said: إيش جملة صادة؟
rows.amal_said: صعبة.
rows.why: Listening: he misheard her صعبة as صادة and asked; she repeated صعبة and he said 'Oh, hard'.

rows.medi_said: أنا بنمسد، uh, بنمسد tilha for her. I don't know. لما، uh، لما تخلص المدرسة.
rows.amal_said: Okay. بنبسط لها.
rows.why: 'Happy for her' is la + -ha (laha / -ilha); he said tilha and 'I don't know'; she recast بنبسط لها (بنمسد itself is S4 sound).
rows.english: I'm happy for her when she finishes school.

rows.medi_said: أنا بنمسد بي آخد، uh, سورة. Or بسورة. بسورة.
rows.amal_said: Did we, did we take the noun for s-photography? ... تصوير. ... بالتصوير. التصوير.
rows.why: After bi the action must be a noun (el-tasweer), not the verb آخد صورة; she asked for the noun and later said 'you can't add be to a verb... it would have to be a noun'.

rows.medi_said: Or بسورة. بسورة.
rows.amal_said: تصوير. Sound familiar?
rows.why: He used صورة (a picture) for the activity photography; she supplied the verbal noun تصوير from basawwer (sheet: i take a photo | Basawwer | بصور).

rows.medi_said: Be, be taswir? Be--
rows.amal_said: Mm-hmm. بالتصوير. التصوير.
rows.why: The activity in general takes el- after bi (bi-l-tasweer); he said be taswir; she recast بالتصوير التصوير.

rows.medi_said: I'm guessing there is a preposition because of this lesson. [laughs] أنا بشتا عليك.
rows.amal_said: Yeah. Great observation. Mm-hmm. عليك؟ ... No.
rows.why: Ishtaa2 takes la- (bashtaa2lak, her chat); he used على; she queried عليك؟ and said No; his 36:50/37:52 'عليك' lines that she called Nice are likely the engine for -lak.

rows.medi_said: أنا بكون مشتاق. No, that doesn't sound--
rows.amal_said: No. ... Bakoon, you didn't get habitual or conditional. So it's just now, I miss you.
rows.why: bakoon is only for habit/conditional; a present state has no 'to be'; she said No and explained, he said أنا مشتاق.

rows.medi_said: أنا شتعلت. Is it شتعلت؟
rows.amal_said: اشتقت. No al in the middle.
rows.chat: ana shta2etlek lamma ma kunti hoan
rows.why: Past of ishtaa2 is ishta2et; he added an extra letter (شتعلت); she gave اشتقت and said no extra sound in the middle.

rows.medi_said: لما مش ... تكون.
rows.amal_said: When you weren't here. ... You weren't.
rows.chat: ana shta2etlek lamma ma kunti hoan
rows.why: 'When you weren't' needs past kaan negated with ma (ma kunti), not mish + present تكون; she prompted 'You weren't' and he gave ما كنت هون.

rows.medi_said: Uh, أنا بتحمس.
rows.amal_said: Mm-hmm. بحمس. ... بحمس. بحمس. أنا، أنا بتحمس.
rows.why: Asked for 'I excite' (make someone excited) he gave the get-form بتحمس; she gave بحمس and he asked 'What'd I say?'.

rows.medi_said: أنا بتحمس, uh, شهر الماضي عشان
rows.amal_said: Wait. Do you mean next month for the next month?
rows.why: He meant next month (holidays coming) but said الماضي (past); she stopped him 'Do you mean next month?' and he said للشهر الجاي.

rows.medi_said: أنا بتخمس للشهر، للشهر الجاي. ... Oh, you're right. أنا بتخمس.
rows.amal_said: So in this case, 'cause you wanna say I am excited now, what would we use? ... أنا متحمس للشهر الجاي.
rows.why: Excited right now is the participle متحمس, not the habitual verb بتحمس; she prompted and then gave أنا متحمس للشهر الجاي (B15 not taught yet - filed, not counted).

rows.medi_said: Um, to arrive is بسوال.
rows.amal_said: No. ... Just flip it.
rows.why: Letters swapped (like daba for bada): arrive is بوصل; she said No and 'Just flip it', he said بوصل.

rows.medi_said: أنا بسوال--
rows.amal_said: No.
rows.why: Said the swapped form again right after her fix; she said No again and he said أنا بوصل - its own slip per GR-32.

rows.medi_said: Yeah. وصلت على بيتك.
rows.amal_said: وصل-- 'cause you used بيتك so make it gender appropriate.
rows.why: Asking Amal (she) when she arrived needs the you-fem ending wselti; she said make it gender appropriate and he said وصلتِ.
rows.english: (What time) did you arrive at your house?

rows.medi_said: أنا بتوجع لما، uh, لما أؤذ، uh, حالي
rows.amal_said: أؤذ حالي؟ ... Uh, that doesn't really work. ... لا، because it's a snip, snip... 'cause it's مؤذ.
rows.right: (she gave no word; أؤذ/قص is only cutting with scissors - e.g. جرحت حالي, reader's reading)
rows.why: He used the scissors-cut verb for cutting/hurting himself; she said it doesn't work because it means snipping with scissors.
rows.english: I get hurt when I cut myself.

rows.medi_said: أنا بتعب من شغل.
rows.amal_said: It's too easy. Come on.
rows.why: Work in general after min usually takes el- (min el-shoghl); she did not fix it, only asked for a harder sentence.

rows.medi_said: أتمرن أو أشتغل، uh, نفس اليوم. The same day.
rows.amal_said: Great job. ... بس make it on the same day or in the same day.
rows.chat: ana bat3ab zyaade lamma atmarran u ashte8el binafs el-yoam
rows.why: 'On the same day' needs the preposition bi (binafs el-yoam); she said make it 'on/in the same day' in English and he said بنفس اليوم.
rows.english: When I work out and work on the same day.

rows.medi_said: uh, هو، um, مزعوج.
rows.amal_said: You're angry at him because he's annoyed? ... Or because he's annoying.
rows.why: He meant annoying (مزعج, sheet: annoying | Muz3ej | مزعج) but said مزعوج (annoyed); she asked 'because he's annoyed?' and he fixed to مزعج.

rows.medi_said: أنا بتضايق على الزباين لما متأخر كتير. متأخرين كتير.
rows.amal_said: ليش؟ ... That's, that's you're sad for them. ... أنا بزعل من أو بدايق.
rows.chat: ana batdaaya2 min el-zabaayen lamma ykoonu mit2a55reen
rows.why: Upset WITH someone is batdaaya2 min; على means sad for them; she said 'that's you're sad for them' and gave من (chat min el-zabaayen).
rows.english: I get upset with customers when they are very late.

rows.medi_said: لما متأخر كتير. متأخرين كتير. ... Akoun.
rows.amal_said: بعدين لما takes-- لما is conditional so what does it take؟ ... يكونوا متأخرين.
rows.why: After lamma a state needs ykoon (ykoonu mit2a55reen); she prompted 'what does it take?', he said Akoun (wrong person) and she gave يكونوا.

rows.medi_said: مش عند Halloween.
rows.amal_said: ما عند.
rows.why: 3ind is negated with ma (ma 3indek), not mish; she recast ما عند and he repeated it.

rows.medi_said: Uh, وافي. ... وافي.
rows.amal_said: Mm-hmm. ... شو واقفة؟
rows.why: For the command 'be upset' he said وافي/واقف (stop); she asked 'what's واقفة?' and he said 'that's stop' and gave إتضايق.

rows.medi_said: [laughs] uh, إتضايق.
rows.amal_said: الضياع إي.
rows.why: Command to Amal (a woman) takes -i; engine wrote her reply as الضياع إي, most likely اتضايقي; he echoed 'إتضايق إيه؟'.

rows.medi_said: أصل. إزعلني.
rows.amal_said: إزعاج. ... اه، don't.
rows.why: Command 'be upset' to a woman is iz3ali; he added -ni (upset me); engine wrote her recast as إزعاج; she then moved to 'don't' and he said ما تزعلي.

rows.medi_said: أنا بفضل إشي أكثر من إشي.
rows.amal_said: أممم. That's more than. ... mm-hmm.
rows.why: Prefer X over Y is bafaddel X 3ala Y; he used aktar min; she said 'That's more than' and he moved to 'prefer something over', chat 3ala ishi.

rows.medi_said: أنا بفضل، um, قهوة على شاي.
rows.amal_said: القهوة على الشاي.
rows.why: Things in general take el- (el-ahwe, el-shaay); she recast القهوة على الشاي and he said 'Gosh darn it'.

rows.medi_said: أنا قهوة، uh, المفضل إشي عندي
rows.amal_said: آه، اسمع عمرك.
rows.why: Mufaddal follows its noun and matches definiteness; he put المفضل before إشي; she moved on (her line is garbled).
